propositions: A new module repeat_fix.py adds a predicate to escalate bug fixes that touch a non-test file modified by 2+ prior bug-fix commits within 7 days on the base branch, catching 12 of 22 labelled repeat-failure bugs that the 150-line floor misses.
The bugfix-size gate now escalates on non-test-lines > 150 OR repeat_fix_escalates, with both signals reported separately in coverage (escalation_reason and repeat_fix_priors fields).
An under-floor repeat-fix (127 non-test lines, prior fixes present) must now be escalated with plan-review attestation, overriding the prior short-circuit at 262-263 of bugfix_size_gate.py.
The test test_under_threshold_diff_never_reads_the_store is rewritten to the narrower invariant: an under-floor diff with no repeat-fix hit performs no attestation classification.
The repeat-fix verdict is stored in a new coverage field (not folded into flagged), preserving the invariant that flagged means the size floor alone, required by --check-planning-corpus.
